name: NeonSat-2 to 6
slot_a_text: NeonSat-2 to 6 are part of the South Korean government's Earth observation micro-satellite constellation NeonSat (New-space Earth Observation Satellite). The NeonSat constellation is the first satellite system developed by the government using a mass-production approach for precise monitoring of the Korean Peninsula.
slot_b_text: 5 launches have left LC-2 since its first in 2018.
